description: This PHP class 'ConfigDao' is part of the OrangeHRM system, providing data access methods for 'Config' entities, including setting, retrieving, and listing configuration values from a repository.

classes.name: ConfigDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Config entity, providing methods to manage configuration data in the database.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the given key to the specified value in the configuration repository. Creates a new Config entity if it does not exist.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the specified key from the configuration repository.

methods.name: getAllValues
methods.description: Returns all configuration key-value pairs as an associative array.
